name: HK Rental Comps + Term & Reversion
description: Direct comparison rental valuation for a commercial/industrial unit, with the Term & Reversion income block. Produces a live-formula .xlsx using the CHFT colour convention (blue = input, black = formula, green = cross-sheet, yellow = headline).

outputs.name: Comps + T&R workbook
outputs.description: One workbook, three sheets (Comps, Summary, Term & Reversion)

fields.label: Subject ancillary platform
fields.help: Ancillary platform area, excluded from saleable area

fields.label: Subject platform weighting
fields.help: e.g. 50% means the platform counts half weight

fields.label: Subject price index
fields.help: RVD index at the valuation date

fields.label: Comparable rentals
fields.help: Each entry: address, rent, sa, price_index, plus optional year/date/floor/aspect/ancillary platform and the five adjustments (floor, quality, sun-weather-view, age, location).

fields.label: Adopted unit rate
fields.help: The valuer's concluded rate. Driven from the adjusted comparables.
